changes.title: Platner announced as speaker for activist-led event in Maine
changes.summary: Former Maine Senate candidate Graham Platner, who dropped out of the race last month amid sexual assault allegations , was announced as a speaker for a Labor Day event in Ellsworth, Maine, next month. The event was organized by the groups Hancock County Activists and Acadia Action Peacemakers, according to information.

changes.title: Maine lifeguard "started swimming like hell" when shark pulled him underwater
changes.summary: A lifeguard said a shark off the coast of Scarborough Beach in Maine grabbed onto his buoy and pulled him 5 feet underwater before he was able to get free.

changes.title: In a competitive Maine Senate race, women voters could be the deciders
changes.summary: The race between Susan Collins and Troy Jackson is one of this year's most high-profile Senate contests. To win, both candidates will need support from an especially powerful voting bloc: Maine women. (Image credit: Scott Eisen).

changes.title: How Troy Jackson went from Maine logger to Democratic nominee for Senate against Susan Collins
changes.summary: Jackson's campaign has focused on his ties to Aroostook County, a sprawling, wooded region known as "The County" to Mainers.

changes.title: One Maine community's fight to save a birthing center
changes.summary: In mid-coast Maine a grassroots coalition is fighting to prevent the proposed closure of Miles Hospital's labor and delivery center.

changes.title: How a community rallied around a little girl and her love for roosters
changes.summary: CBS News contributor David Begnaud shows how the small town of Ogunquit, Maine, rallied around a 6-year-old girl when local code enforcement officials told the girl's family to take a flock of tin roosters off their property.

changes.title: Bernie Sanders on if he regrets Platner endorsement: ‘Easier to be a Monday morning quarterback’
changes.summary: In an exclusive interview with Meet the Press, Sen. Bernie Sanders (I-Vt.) shares his thoughts on the Maine Senate race after Sen. John Fetterman (D-Pa.) criticized Sanders for having “no regrets” over endorsing Graham Platner.
